easyPrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
description:
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it, creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast Delif's Cone from the top of your library by paying 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
